title: amr-from-light-curves: machine learning characterisation of space objects from light curves and orbital parameters
description: Code accompanying the ICGS3-26 paper 'Fusing Light Curves and Orbital Parameters for Machine Learning-Based Characterisation of Space Objects: A Reproducible Study on Public Data'. The pipeline estimates area-to-mass ratio and classifies object type by combining public optical light curves from MMT-9 and SDLCD with orbital parameters derived from Space-Track two-line element histories, validated against ESA DISCOS ground truth.
